performance.verdict: Ads dark 18 days; score is green on stale data, not live performance.

findings.text: Spend has been $0 every day since Aug 6 — 18 consecutive zero-spend days. All 21 leads and $574.80 in spend are pre-blackout. No current CPL is computable.
Score of 100 is misleading: it reads the 28-day window which includes the active July period. Real-time health is unknown — money is not working because it is not running.
GHL shows 26 contacts but 0 opportunities created and 0 appointments in the 28-day window, despite 21 leads arriving — intake pipeline is not converting contacts to opps at all.
IG reach spiked to 248 on Aug 25 (from a near-zero baseline since Aug 6) while paid spend remains $0 — likely organic or a boosted post not captured in Meta Ads spend data.
Search clicks rose +26.96% week-over-week (43 clicks on Aug 24, highest in 45 days) while GA4 sessions fell -19.07% — directional disconnect likely reflects GA4 double-count caveat, not a real drop.

suggestions.text: Immediately confirm why Meta spend went to $0 on Aug 6 — payment, account, or policy issue. Restore budget to $65–75/day on confirmation.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta ads have shown $0 spend every day from Aug 6 through Aug 25 — 18 days dark. Hamza/Hamdan must check the Meta Business Manager today for payment failures, account flags, or policy holds. Once root cause is confirmed and cleared, restore the CROA CBO budget to the prior $65–75/day level (last active CPL was $27.37 on 21 leads). Confirm resumed delivery by Aug 28 with at least 1 lead registered in GHL.

suggestions.text: Repair GHL intake: 26 contacts, 0 opportunities created — leads are arriving but never becoming pipeline. Audit workflow with Andrew.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL received 26 contacts over 28 days but created 0 opportunities and booked 0 appointments — leads are entering CRM but the automation or manual step to create an opportunity is broken or skipped. Sohib to loop in Andrew (intake/Zoho) to audit the GHL workflow stage triggers this week. Success is defined as new opportunities being created for every qualified contact within 24 hours of lead arrival; verify by Aug 30 on the next batch of leads once ads resume.

suggestions.text: Watch IG reach spike (248 on Aug 25) to determine if a non-tracked boost is running outside of reported Meta spend.
suggestions.monday_item_name: Watch IG reach vs paid spend
suggestions.monday_update: IG reach jumped to 248 on Aug 25 while Meta Ads spend remains $0 — this suggests either an organic post performing unusually well or a boosted post not reflected in the campaign dashboard. Monitor the next 3 days of IG reach data after ads resume to determine if this is additive reach or an untracked spend event. Re-check on Aug 29; if reach holds above 150 with confirmed $0 paid, surface to Hamza for investigation.
